description: Heavy rainfall has flooded several residential areas and blocked major roads.
A strong earthquake damaged buildings and caused injuries in multiple neighborhoods.
A large fire broke out in a commercial building and nearby residents were evacuated.
Moderate flooding has affected roads and several local shops after continuous rain.
A small landslide blocked a rural road after heavy rainfall but no major injuries were reported.
A powerful cyclone is approaching coastal areas with strong winds and heavy rainfall.
Minor waterlogging has affected a few streets after short periods of rainfall.
A moderate earthquake caused cracks in several old buildings but no major injuries.
A small fire was contained quickly inside a local shop with limited property damage.
Heavy rain caused a landslide that damaged houses and blocked an important road.
